mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 39 degrees with clear skies over the Verona Public Library and we are under a New Moon.

City officials announced that asphalt repairs are set for Tuesday, November 10, and Wednesday, November 11. Work will take place on Nine Mound Road, Morningside Boulevard, and Mozart Street, with additional patching on Todd Street and Edward Street. Please keep an eye out for no-parking signs between 7 AM and 7 PM.

There is plenty to do, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness happening today. Tomorrow brings a busy schedule with trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's and pizza deals at Lake Lou-ee.
On October 23, officers made contact with two 13-year-olds riding eMotos on Ashton Drive, resulting in citations for their parents for permitting them to drive a motor vehicle.
Today's flavor is Georgia Peach. The store opens today at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 10:00 PM.
